listing.name: Threads of Fate / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Build and play Threads of Fate on Windows or Linux with your own matching USA and Canada PlayStation disc and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. You can also use a separately prepared upstream copy.

steps.title: Use the exact original files
steps.instruction: Use your own Threads of Fate (USA, Canada) disc (SLUS-01019) with its single data track and your own retail SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Set up the managed Windows or Linux player
steps.instruction: In Portcove, select the complete matching CHD and BIOS. Keep both original files in place. Portcove builds the player from the setup kit with its registered toolchain. Choose Play after the build finishes.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Mac copy
steps.instruction: Choose the official Mac ZIP from the upstream releases. Use -macos-x64.zip for Intel or -macos-arm64.zip for Apple silicon. Extract the complete kit to a writable folder and follow its README-SETUP.txt, which asks for your own SCPH-1001 BIOS.

steps.title: Build and add the completed Mac player
steps.instruction: Run Threads_of_Fate_Recompiled from the kit folder and choose Generate & rebuild. Keep the CUE and every referenced BIN together if using CUE/BIN. In Portcove, select build-release/Threads_of_Fate_Recompiled as the player and build-release as its start folder.

warnings: Portcove checks the first data track and track count. Keep the complete disc intact.
Mac setup, replacement and backups belong to you and the upstream kit. Native setup, gameplay and populated-save behavior remain unverified.

references.title: Keep the original files and your data
references.instruction: Keep your disc and BIOS separately. For a Mac copy, close the game and back up the complete working folder and its saves, settings and installed mods before replacing the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Select your own Threads of Fate (USA, Canada) complete CHD (SLUS-01019, 1 track) and retail SCPH-1001 BIOS. Portcove builds a private player from the upstream setup kit and retains its declared saves, settings and installed mods. Bundled mods belong to the runtime version. Runtime rollback carries the current player data. Mac setup is upstream-owned.
